propositions: A manual-dispatch-only GitHub Actions workflow must boot the amd64-only DC image pinned by digest and interrogate its capabilities (templates, issue types, fields, screens, workflows, statuses, transitions, priorities, link types, field length limits) via REST, producing structured pass/fail/different verdicts for each entry in rebar's hardcoded vocabularies rather than live discovery

The workflow's output must be committed as evidence-backed data (raw request/response pairs per finding) that is consumed by the harness setup assertion to declare the environment contract, not regenerated at test time
The image digest must be derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line, not hardcoded separately, and the committed answers must include the digest so staleness after a re-pin is detectable by assertion
The workflow must detect and report link-direction errors (blocks vs depends_on inversion, inward vs outward name mismatches) by end-to-end write-then-read experiments, not by name presence alone

Field length limits (summary, label, description, comment) must be measured empirically by writing at limit-1/limit/limit+1, reading back to detect silent truncation, and reporting the instance's actual configuration value rather than relying on hardcoded constants
The workflow cannot mutate the instance (REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1), cannot run on push/PR/schedule (dispatch-only asserted by test), and must batch all questions into one run to minimize boot cycles
